description: Defines the fapi_to_phy_fastpath_translator class, including configuration, dependencies, and internal classes for translating slot-based FAPI messages into PHY data types, managing slot controllers, and storing PDSCH PDUs.

classes.name: fapi_to_phy_fastpath_translator
classes.description: Main class for translating slot-based FAPI messages into PHY data types, managing slot controllers, and handling PDU repositories.

classes.name: fapi_to_phy_fastpath_translator::slot_based_upper_phy_controller
classes.description: Manages PHY controller per slot, following RAII pattern.

classes.name: fapi_to_phy_fastpath_translator::slot_based_upper_phy_controller_manager
classes.description: Manages multiple slot controllers, providing acquisition and release based on slot.

classes.name: fapi_to_phy_fastpath_translator::pdsch_pdu_repository
classes.description: Stores PDSCH PDUs for processing, associated with a specific slot.

methods.name: fapi_to_phy_fastpath_translator::on_last_message
methods.description: Handles the last message in a slot.

methods.name: fapi_to_phy_fastpath_translator::handle_new_slot
methods.description: Processes a new slot, finalizing previous PDUs and resetting repositories.
